meta.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
meta.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 转 html", "微信外链转底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转为带微信主题的 HTML
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把 Markdown 文档转为适合微信发布的 HTML
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to convert Markdown to HTML for WeChat publication

howto.what: 把 Markdown 文件转成带内联 CSS 的样式化 HTML，输出到同目录同名 .html；若该文件已存在会先备份。支持代码高亮、公式、脚注、提示框，以及把 Mermaid 图渲染成 PNG。
howto.when: 当你提出 “markdown to html”、“md 转 html” 等要求，或需要从 Markdown 得到样式化 HTML 输出时触发。

say.text: 把 article.md 转成 HTML，用 grace 主题。
把这篇 Markdown 里的外链转成文末引用。
say.note: 对应 --cite；微信链接仍保持原样。

say.text: 转换时保留正文第一个标题，标题改成「我的文章」。

howto.what_en: Converts a Markdown file into styled HTML with inline CSS, written next to the input; an existing HTML file is backed up first. Supports code highlighting, math, footnotes, alerts, and Mermaid diagrams rendered to PNG.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for "markdown to html", "md 转 html", or similar, or need styled HTML output from markdown.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to HTML using the grace theme.
say_en.note: Writes article.html next to the input.

say_en.text: Turn the external links in this markdown into bottom citations.
Keep the first heading and set the title to "My Article".
